measured_by: npm install apex-psi-mcp@1.3.0 from the public registry, then a tools/list call over stdio

tools.name: seal
tools.title: Seal content
tools.description: Record content in the APEX PSI append-only ledger and return a receipt: SHA-256 hash, an Ed25519 signature over the Merkle leaf, and post-quantum ML-DSA-65 (plus LMS-W4-SHA256 when a slot is available — the receipt's own algorithm field states which). Proves that this content existed and has not changed since the timestamp. It never proves the contents are true. Free tier: 20 operations/minute, 100/day, no account needed. Side effect: it appends one record to the public ledger; nothing is edited or deleted. Output: a receipt in JSON, with the hash, the signature algorithms that receipt carries, and a URL anyone can check. A failure returns a tool error whose text is JSON: { success: false, error }.

tools.name: verify
tools.title: Verify a receipt
tools.description: Confirm a seal's integrity against the APEX PSI append-only ledger. Accepts a receipt object (from the seal tool) or a raw SHA-256 hash. Reports whether the hash is present and anchored — integrity, not the truth of the original content. Read-only: nothing is written and no record changes. Output: a JSON report stating whether the hash was found and whether it is anchored. A failure returns a tool error whose text is JSON: { success: false, error }.

tools.name: anchor
tools.title: Bitcoin anchoring history
tools.description: Read the Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) anchoring record for the ledger's Merkle roots. Defaults to action:'history', which is read-only and returns each anchor transaction with its txid, block height, confirmation state and how many ledger entries it covers. Pass action:'verify' with a txid to check one transaction, or action:'anchor' to explicitly request that pending roots be aggregated and submitted to the OTS calendars. Defaults to 'history' so a routine call never triggers a batch write. An anchor counts as confirmed only when a real Bitcoin block contains it. Read-only for action 'history' and 'verify'; only action 'anchor' writes, by submitting pending roots to the OTS calendars. Output: a JSON list of anchor transactions with txid, block height and confirmation state. A failure returns a tool error whose text is JSON: { success: false, error }.

tools.name: cite
tools.title: Generate citation
tools.description: Generate a citation for a sealed receipt in APA, BibTeX, or MLA format, citing the APEX PSI ledger entry. Read-only and entirely local: it formats a citation from the receipt you pass in and makes no network call. Output: the citation string in the format you asked for.

tools.name: verify_chain
tools.title: Verify a receipt chain
tools.description: Independently verify a chain of receipts against the APEX PSI ledger. Recomputes each hash's presence and integrity and reports Merkle chain continuity. Returns a verification report — a recomputation result, not an opinion or a certification. Read-only: it only looks receipts up and recomputes the chain; nothing is written. Output: a JSON report per receipt (found, verified) and an overall chain-intact verdict. A failure returns a tool error whose text is JSON: { success: false, error }.
